name: mnemosyne
description: Long-term memory for Claude Code across sessions and repos, on its own private copy of the Mnemosyne Memory engine and its own store.

scope.title: Memory scope
scope.description: global: one memory shared by every repo. per-project: each repo keeps its own, and facts saved as global are seen everywhere.

showActivity.title: Show activity
showActivity.description: on: a dim line in the conversation each time Mnemosyne recalls memories, or will recall again after a compaction, plus a status line under the prompt. status: the status line only. off: silent.

activityLog.title: Activity log
activityLog.description: on: each memory call (recall, remember, update, forget, stats, and calls from other MCP clients) adds one line to ~/.claude/mnemosyne/activity.jsonl, owner-only, capped at 1 MB with one backup, secrets masked. off: nothing is written.

guardMode.title: Save guard mode
guardMode.description: Every save is checked first. Secrets, empty or very short text and text over 4000 characters are always refused. strict: a save with a warning (dated task chatter, text over 1500 characters) is refused until the call is resent with confirm: true. warn: such a save is stored, flagged in its metadata, and the reply shows the warnings.

memoryDir.title: Memory store
memoryDir.description: Leave empty for the default: ~/.claude/mnemosyne/store (macOS, Linux) or %USERPROFILE%\.claude\mnemosyne\store (Windows). Or give an absolute path, or one starting with ~/.

rememberTerms.title: Remember terms
rememberTerms.description: Leave empty for the defaults: remember:, remember that, note that, save to memory. A prompt starting with one of these asks Claude to save the rest. Type none to turn this off.

recallTerms.title: Recall terms
recallTerms.description: Leave empty for the defaults: recall:, what do you remember about, check memory. A prompt starting with one of these looks up memories for it. Type none to turn this off.

externalMcp.title: Share with other MCP clients
externalMcp.description: Off by default. On: writes ~/.claude/mnemosyne/bin/mnemosyne-mcp (mnemosyne-mcp.cmd on Windows), a stdio MCP server other tools (Cursor, Codex, claude mcp add) can use with this memory. Off removes it.

extractionModel.title: Knowledge extraction model
extractionModel.description: The model that pulls facts, preferences, instructions, dated events and relations out of each saved memory in the background (an alias such as haiku, or a full model id). It also drives /mnemosyne-tags. off turns extraction off: no model call, and /mnemosyne-tags says so.

embeddings.title: Embeddings (meaning-based recall)
embeddings.description: auto: on only on macOS on Apple Silicon (the tested platform), off elsewhere. on: always on. off: keyword-only recall. Embeddings run on this machine only; /mnemosyne-setup downloads the model once (about 63 MB from huggingface.co), and /mnemosyne-embed fills vectors for memories saved before.
